what.text: This page follows refugees from Ukraine living in Romania.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 199461 Ukrainian refugees in Romania, 3.8% of all Ukrainian refugees.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, at war level in every one of those years.
Before that it records armed conflict over Novorossiya territory, with the DPR and LPR, from 2014 to 2022.

when.text: The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 and 2024 to 2025, with big changes between 2021 and 2022 and between 2023 and 2024.
UNHCR's figure for Romania rose from 177996 at the end of 2024 to 199461 at the end of 2025, its highest.
Returns from Romania to Ukraine were highest in 2023 and 2024 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Romania only, and UNHCR adds notes to some of them.
People displaced inside Ukraine are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
